mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_harness_config (agent_id, client_id, client_name, client_type, sequence, step_prompt, create_time) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{clientId}, #{clientName}, #{clientType}, #{sequence}, #{stepPrompt}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_id, client_id, client_name, client_type, sequence, step_prompt, create_time FROM ai_agent_harness_config WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, agent_id, client_id, client_name, client_type, sequence, step_prompt, create_time FROM ai_agent_harness_config WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sequence
SELECT id, agent_id, client_id, client_name, client_type, sequence, step_prompt, create_time FROM ai_agent_harness_config WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY sequence
SELECT id, agent_id, client_id, client_name, client_type, sequence, step_prompt, create_time FROM ai_agent_harness_config WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND client_id = #{clientId}
SELECT id, agent_id, client_id, client_name, client_type, sequence, step_prompt, create_time FROM ai_agent_harness_config ORDER BY agent_id, sequence
